s.en: Emulate iostat for NFS mount points using /proc/self/mountstats

o.en: or --attr displays statistics related to the attribute cache
or --dir displays statistics related to directory operations
or --help shows help message and exit
--list=LIST only print stats for first LIST mount points
or --page displays statistics related to the page cache
or --sort Sort NFS mount points by ops/second
show program's version number and exit
